data.title: 不知火舞 · 海滨道场的扇子与浪花
data.description: 【海滨道场露台·正午】不知火舞穿着红色泳装外搭白色短衫，赤脚坐在木质海台边练习折扇；一朵浪花越过台阶，她用扇面接住水珠，随后对镜头摆出胜利姿势。
data.action: 海滨木台边练扇接住浪花水珠，转向镜头摆出胜利姿势
data.lighting: bright noon sun on red fabric and spray
data.mood: 把晨训变成热烈海滨假日
data.promptProse: Mai Shiranui from Fatal Fury wears a crimson athletic swimsuit with a white wrap shirt, folding fan and red ribbon sandals. She sits barefoot at the seaside dojo deck, practicing a crisp fan flourish as spray crosses the steps. She catches the droplets on the fan, then turns toward the viewer in a playful victory pose, her high ponytail bright against the ocean. bright noon sun on red fabric and spray.
